 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The object is a rectangular 3-colored frame with one extra 3 marker inside.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(grid[r][c] == 3 for c in range(w)) >= 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)) >= 2]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(top + 1, bottom)
               for c in range(left + 1, right)
               if grid[r][c] == 3]
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
    return out
"
